description:
The Secretary of the Air Force, Office of Competitive Activities, Concepts Development and Management (SAF/CDMX) will host an Industry Day on 16 March 2026 in Springfield, Virginia.  The purpose of this session is to provide cleared secure cloud service providers with detailed technical information and solicit feedback regarding requirements and/or limitations for a modernized capability for information sharing.  Cleared secure cloud providers planning to attend should be familiar with JWCC/C2E/Edge or denied, degraded, intermittent, or limited environments (DDIL). All classification levels may be discussed with a focus on SEC//REL.

This is in preparation for the development of a requirement. Participants should be prepared to engage in substantive technical discussions.  Only cleared secure cloud service providers are invited to participate in this event. 

Presentations and discussions during this event will be up to TS/SCI clearance. Accordingly, all attendees must possess a valid TS/SCI clearance and be eligible for access to program-specific information. We look forward to your participation and valuable contributions to this critical modernization effort.

Interested attendees must pre-register by e-mail to Meg Baer, megan.baer@us.af.mil and Lauren Lord, lauren.lord@us.af.mil on or before 5 March 2026. Please provide the individual’s name, company, CAGE code, phone, and e-mail address. Additional one-on-one sessions may be scheduled by annotating interest within submission of attendees.  If desired, annotate time preference for one-on-one session, but selection cannot be guaranteed.   Companies are limited to 3 attendees each.

 Once approved for attendance, all attendees must pass their security clearance information to the event security POC.  Additional instructions will be provided.

Disclaimer:  This event is for informational and planning purposes only and is being conducted in accordance with FAR 15.201. It does not constitute a solicitation and does not commit the Government to any contractual actions. All information shared during the Industry Day is pre-decisional, subject to change, and will be superseded by the formal solicitation, once released.
